author: Parsifal-2045
body: #### PR description: This PR makes the Alpaka fast pixel CPE read the hit position errors from the genError payload for Phase-2, as it already does for Phase-1, and fixes two places where the code assumed the Phase-1 module layout. - **`errorFromDB` position bin** (`pixelCPEforDevice.h`): the cluster x position is binned over the module width to read the per-module genError tables. The half width came from the compile-time `TrackerTraits::xOffset`, which is right for Phase-1 (all modules alike) but a dummy value for Phase-2, whose modules come in different widths. It is now computed from each module's row count, `0.5 * nRows + bigPixXCorrection`. For Phase-1 and HIonPhase1 this is the same number as before (`0.5 * 160 + 1 = 81 = -xOffset`). - **Phase-2 errors from genErrors** (`pixelCPEforDevice.h`): the `errorFromDB` specialisation, which fell back to the hard-coded `errorFromSize` tables, is removed. Phase-2 now goes through the generic `errorFromDB`. - **Average angle** (`PixelCPEFastParamsHost.cc`): the sampling point was hard-coded 40 rows from the module centre, i.e. half of the 80-row Phase-1 ROC. It is now `0.5 * nRowsRoc`, which is the same value for Phase-1 and follows the ROC size elsewhere. - **genError charge-bin scan** (`PixelCPEFastParamsHost.cc`): when a charge bin was skipped, the scan stepped `qbin` the wrong way (`+= 1`). The skipped-bin branch then fired again on every following iteration without advancing the charge, so all remaining bins were filled with the same threshold and errors. It now steps to the skipped bin (`-= 1`), fills that one entry, and the scan resumes. This code is shared by all topologies. - **`numberOfPixelModules`** (`SimplePixelTopology.h`): new trait for the pixel-module count, equal to `numberOfModules` for `Phase1` and `Phase2`. It is used in the size assert of `fillParamsForDevice`, since the CPE parameters are pixel-only. - **`Phase2::xOffset`**: the value is unchanged; the comment now explains that no single value fits and that only the legacy `pixelCPEforGPU` code still reads it. - **`hltESPPixelCPEFastParams_cfi.py`** (HLT_75e33): `LoadTemplatesFromDB` and `UseErrorsFromTemplates` are set explicitly to `True`. Both are already the defaults, so this does not change the configuration behaviour. The legacy `PixelCPEFast` / `pixelCPEforGPU` code is not touched. Expected changes: - Phase-2 (HLT_75e33 and any other workflow using the Alpaka pixel rechits): pixel hit errors change, and with them pixel tracks and everything built on them. - Phase-1 and HIonPhase1: the position bin and the average angle are numerically identical. The charge-bin fix can change the errors of a module only if its genError payload skips a charge bin. #### PR validation: Locally checked the impact on PixelTracks, by running 1000 TTbar events with 200 PU. The main effect is visible in dxy, dz, and phi pulls: dxy pull vs eta (Sigma) | dz pull vs eta (Sigma) | phi pull vs eta (Sigma) |:-------------:|:-----------------:|:----------------------:| | | All plots can be found [here](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/test/CPE/hltPhase2Pixel_hltAssociatorByHits/?search=pull)
title: Take Phase-2 hit errors from genError in the Alpaka Pixel CPE
